summary: Register and route global Office sector agents reproducibly in Codex Desktop
goal: Make the existing 15 sector profiles reusable across projects and chats without pretending permanent execution.

authorization.source: Direct user request 2026-10-23 to apply global agents and upload plugin updates.
authorization.allowed: Scoped implementation, tests, branch push and review PR.
authorization.excluded: Merge, deploy, unrelated installation, permission/model/MCP changes. No live host apply in this scope.

protected_paths: existing user config outside owned agent registrations
requirements: AC-01: Reproducible opt-in plan/check/apply registration of all 15 office_* profiles from canonical contracts; no persistent agents or automatic invocation of all sectors.
AC-02: Default plan/check read-only; explicit apply backs up affected files and preserves unrelated TOML settings, user files and existing customizations; conflicts block safely.
AC-03: Global instructions route activated sectors to actual registered host subagents, distinguish registration from execution, and retain human release gates.
AC-04: Independent QA covers missing/invalid configuration, repeat apply, collisions/custom changes, dry run and preservation; docs accurately distinguish installed/registered/available/executed.
AC-05: Isolated reviewed commit, branch and PR published with exact validation/limitations; no merge/deploy or changed permissions/models/MCP.
